picks.title: Enigma raises $71M to make controlling a robot as easy as adjusting the volume
picks.why_it_matters: A $71M seed round led by Index and Ribbit signals massive investor appetite for robotics UX/interface plays, and validates that simplifying robot control is now a fundable category at scale.

picks.title: Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
picks.why_it_matters: A strategic Nvidia partnership with an elite AI safety lab emerging from stealth could reshape compute access dynamics and signals which AI safety approaches are gaining infrastructure backing.

picks.title: Antares raises $470M to build nuclear reactors for the US military
picks.why_it_matters: A massive raise for small modular reactors with DoD as anchor customer validates defense-as-first-customer as a viable GTM for deeptech energy startups, opening dealflow opportunities in adjacent nuclear supply chain plays.
